purpose: Art-direction targets for the AAA overhaul. Each target is a GENERATED paint-over of a real engine frame (or a feature concept that uses one as its reference). They are goals for the renderer, not engine captures, and must never be presented as in-game evidence.
tool: Higgsfield MCP (image edit with a reference image)

plates.note: Plates are unedited real-time engine frames from branch codex/cinematic-anime-overhaul @ 1a11e13, captured at 1600x900 with ?hud=0&seed=audit-0923&scene=<scene> after launching through the real UI and sailing with keyboard input. Not capture mode. Originals live in output/aaa-audit-2026-09-23/plates-selected/ (gitignored); the left half of each compare/*.jpg shows the plate.

targets.brief: Same camera and ship; unified cel/ink finish, bow wave, hull-hugging foam, V wake, calmer stylized ocean, lush islands.
Authored world art: sandstone sea arch with waterfalls, Marine fortress, terraced port town, shore foam, shallow-water colour, curved wake.
Peak broadside moment: staggered muzzle flashes, inked cel smoke, glowing shot trails, water columns, splinters, fire.
True moonlit night: moon path, lanterns, fort torches and searchlight, bioluminescent wake.
Grand Line storm: lightning, rain sheets, wave larger than the ship, spray over the bow, god rays.
Island discovery reveal: colossal landmark island emerging from mist, sea stacks, sunbeams.
Minimal combat HUD: ship ring with battery arcs, firing wedge on the water, enemy nameplates, minimap, bounty chip, special gauge, hit marker. Enemy names in the mock-up are placeholders.
Console-grade front end: brush logo, wanted-poster ship cards, chunky stats, SET SAIL with controller prompts, living harbor.
Sea King boss breach beside the Sunny.
Special-move spectacle: airborne launch, ring shockwave, speed lines.
Finishing blow: galleon snaps and sinks, fire, sailors overboard, whirl of foam, floating loot.
Boarding action across grappling lines. Illustrative; not an achievable in-engine camera target.

cost: 12 generations, about 26 Higgsfield credits (2 per 2K edit, 2.75 per GPT Image 2.5 high 2K).
